title: Sell Mineral Rights in Excel, AL
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Excel, AL | Cash Offer
metaDescription: Excel, Monroe County mineral owner in the south Alabama Smackover trend? Get a clear, honest cash offer built from your real lease history.
heroLead: Excel is a small Monroe County community sitting within the broader south Alabama Smackover trend, timber and farm country where oil leasing has come in waves rather than as one continuous boom.
intro: Families around Excel often hold mineral interests tied to land that has been logged, farmed, and occasionally leased for oil and gas exploration across several generations. If your family's history fits that pattern, the mineral rights are usually the one piece of the original tract that never got sold along with everything else.

sections.heading: Waves of leasing, not constant activity
paragraphs: Monroe County has seen periodic bursts of oil and gas leasing interest tied to broader exploration cycles across the south Alabama Smackover trend, rather than the kind of dense, continuous development seen closer to Escambia County. That means an Excel-area interest might have an old lease from one of these earlier cycles, current production from a specific successful well, or no lease history at all, depending on exactly where the tract sits.
We research your specific parcel rather than assuming the whole area behaves the same way.

sections.heading: Monroe County Probate records in Monroeville
paragraphs: Deed, lease, and estate records for Excel and the rest of Monroe County are filed at the county seat in Monroeville. If your family's ownership passed down without formal probate, that office is where we would begin confirming your legal right to sell, and we typically handle this research directly on your behalf.
We ask for whatever documentation you already have, even an old, faded lease copy can save us meaningful research time.

faqs.question: Is there active oil production near Excel right now?
faqs.answer: It varies by specific tract; some Monroe County parcels have current production while others sit outside any active unit, so we check yours individually.

faqs.question: My family's lease is old and I am not sure it is still active. What now?
faqs.answer: We research current well status tied to the specific legal description on your lease to determine whether it remains in effect.

faqs.question: Where would my family's Excel-area deed be filed?
faqs.answer: With the Monroe County Probate Office in Monroeville, which holds records for the entire county.

faqs.question: Can you evaluate an interest with very little documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can start from public deed and probate records if your own paperwork is thin or missing.

faqs.question: What if my Excel interest is split among several cousins?
faqs.answer: We can purchase each cousin's undivided share independently, so the whole family does not need to agree before anyone can sell.
